verdict.rationale: Docs say Claude loads skills automatically when a natural-language request matches the skill's description, with `/skill-name` as an explicit fallback (docs-2, docs-25, docs-17, docs-32). Several hands-on community reports concretely contradict that: users say skills are hit-or-miss to trigger even with proper descriptions, are sometimes ignored even when explicitly asked for, and work better when pasted into AGENTS.md (comm-7, comm-9, comm-11, comm-12). Some users still report success asking the model to use a skill (comm-3, comm-13). Missing for 10: reliable natural-language triggering confirmed by independent hands-on evidence, and documentation of how natural-language routing behaves when it fails.
